verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs describe Agent Mode, which turns natural-language instructions into actions across the API lifecycle, such as sending requests, fixing errors, updating tests, visualizing responses and writing documentation. Postbot AI usage is capped at 50 activities per user per month on free use and otherwise requires a purchased add-on. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and documentation of how far Agent Mode covers the whole product beyond the listed tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With Agent Mode, you can turn your words into action across the API lifecycle. Send requests, fix errors, update tests, and more, using natural language.
You can ask Agent Mode to add tests to requests, visualize responses, write documentation, and more.
